en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a gently curving cobblestone street lined with old townhouses. In the distance rises a tall clocktower with an ornate spire, likely the town hall tower. The foreground shows shopfronts with German signage on both sides of the street. At the bottom margin of the image there is a caption in German identifying the view as a look into Schloßstraße with the town hall tower in Waldheim, Saxony. On the right façade a sign reads "Blumenhaus Nizza" and large letters "Nizza".
